measurement: Threat-aware ordering (tier 2, T56): the butterfly history split by threats to the quiet move's from- and to-square, with two definitions of a threatened square: any enemy attack (use_threat_buckets alone), or an attack by a cheaper enemy piece (use_cheaper_threats too: pawn attacks for knights and bishops, pawn or minor-piece attacks for rooks, pawn, minor or rook attacks for queens; pawns count enemy pawn attacks, kings any attack). Declared 2026-11-05 before any run. Ties go to any attack (the simpler set, built in one pass).
